evidence_note: NEMA states Mokwa was overwhelmed by a devastating flash flood on 28 May 2025 following torrential rainfall.
NEMA documents flooding on 27 July 2025 after rainfall from Saturday night into early Sunday affecting Yolde Pate Shagari Sabon Pegi and adjoining Yola South communities.
NEMA documents early-morning flash floods on 30 July 2025 after hours of intense rainfall across Maiduguri and Jere communities.
NEMA states heavy overnight rainfall caused flooding in Tofa and Lolitapi communities on 12 August 2025.
NEMA records a flash flood at about 3pm on 3 September 2025 after several hours of intense rainfall affecting Bekaji Jambutu Bachure and adjoining areas.
NEMA states the Jurara community flood occurred on 4 September 2025 and destroyed 135 houses while displacing over 500 residents.
NEMA documents severe flash flooding across 13 communities in Yola North and Yola South on 16 September 2025 after heavy rainfall.
